units.source_text: 这考试办法，叫作“放岛”，即教每人乘坐一舟，放乎中流，朝着岛的方向漂去。

en.t: This examination method was called “releasing to the island”: each person was made to board a boat and drift from midstream toward the island.

units.source_text: 可使各人在舟中作诗文，不能与他人交谈。

en.t: Each person could compose poems and prose in the boat, but could not talk with anyone else.
